WITH high_value_cte AS (
  SELECT 
    a.artregistry,
    a.artname,
    a.conservestatus,
    s.insvalueusd,
    r.histsignrating,
    r.cultscore,
    c.treatpriority,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.insvalueusd > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value'
      WHEN r.histsignrating >= 10 AND r.cultscore >= 90 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS value_category
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN artifactsecurityaccess s ON a.artregistry = s.artref
  JOIN artifactratings r ON a.artregistry = r.artref
  JOIN conservationandmaintenance c ON a.artregistry = c.artrefmaintained
)
SELECT 
  artregistry AS artifact_id,
  artname,
  insvalueusd AS insured_value,
  conservestatus,
  value_category
FROM high_value_cte
WHERE conservestatus = 'Critical'
  AND treatpriority = 'Urgent'
  AND (insvalueusd > 1000000 OR (histsignrating >= 10 AND cultscore >= 90));
